name: mandarin-the-wild-reader
description: Read Mandarin messages, article excerpts and subtitles with contextual word cards, pinyin and phrase parts. Optionally connect Mandarin The Wild to save words you choose to Backpack.

interface.longDescription:
Understand real Mandarin messages, article excerpts and subtitle passages inside ChatGPT. Open the original text and hover or tap a word for its meaning in context, expected pinyin and phrase parts. The reader shows alternatives and uncertain readings rather than treating every interpretation as settled.

Reading needs no Mandarin The Wild account. Optionally connect your account and deliberately save a chosen word, with its passage, to your existing Backpack. Hovering and reading never save words.

Paste the passage you want to read, up to 4,096 characters at a time. This reader does not fetch article links, transcribe media or certify proficiency.
defaultPrompt: Help me read this Chinese message: 明天方便的话，咱们一起吃个饭吧。
Explain 拐弯抹角 in this sentence: 你别拐弯抹角，有话直说。
Open these Mandarin subtitles word by word: 我还以为你不来了呢。

positive.prompt: Open this Chinese message in the interactive Mandarin reader: 明天方便的话，咱们一起吃个饭吧。
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the exact message, display its words with pinyin and let desktop hover or phone tap open word cards. Reading does not create a Backpack item.

positive.description: Explain a whole idiom in context
positive.prompt: What does 拐弯抹角 mean here? 你别拐弯抹角，有话直说。
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the idiom at code-point offset 2 in the exact passage. Show the full idiom card, its expected pinyin, contextual meaning and parts. Do not save it.

positive.prompt: Help me read these Mandarin subtitles word by word: 我还以为你不来了呢。
positive.expected_behavior: Open the exact supplied text with the same parser used by MTW. Hovering or tapping a word returns a contextual card. No transcription or URL retrieval occurs.

positive.prompt: Open 鸡不吃了。 and show the available readings without deciding which one I meant.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the parser's unresolved structural alternatives when inspecting the passage. Do not invent one settled meaning, mark the word known or save an unchosen interpretation.

positive.description: Explicitly save to the checked account and verify Backpack
positive.prompt: Connect my Mandarin The Wild account, check which account is connected, and save 茶 from 今天我喝了一杯茶。 to that account's Backpack.
positive.expected_behavior: Complete sign-in and explicit consent, show the destination account, inspect 茶 at code-point offset 7 and save only after the requested confirmation. Reusing the same operation UUID after a lost reply creates no duplicate. Opening Backpack in that same account shows 茶 with its source passage.

negative.description: Unsupported article retrieval: ask for the text
negative.prompt: Fetch a Chinese article from https://example.com/article and read it for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin accepts pasted passages and ask for the article excerpt. Do not fetch the link or fabricate article text.

negative.description: Unsupported media transcription: ask for subtitles
negative.prompt: Transcribe this video and teach me every Mandarin word in it.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin does not transcribe media and ask for existing Mandarin subtitles or a transcript. Do not pretend to have watched or transcribed the video.

negative.description: Reading alone must never persist words
negative.prompt: Read 今天我喝了一杯茶。 and explain 茶. I only want to understand it; do not save anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Use only read_mandarin or inspect_mandarin_word. Do not connect an account unnecessarily, invoke save_mandarin_word, mark a word known or write a Backpack item.

review.commerce_description: The reader does not sell products, process payments or promote account upgrades.

publication.release_notes: Initial public reader release: exact Mandarin passages, contextual word cards, expected pinyin, phrase parts, uncertainty and optional explicit Backpack saving. Lookup, status and save changes preserve reader height; long cards scroll within their reserved area. Dedicated reviewer sign-in and a desktop/phone walkthrough support review.
